issuer: the Arkansas Department of Finance and Administration, Office of Driver Services
note: Driver Services' non-commercial licence page (read 2026-10-30) gives the Class D licence, ages 21 and over, at $40.00 for 8 years (ages 18 to 21, prorated to a month past the 21st birthday); it is kept from 21, the youngest age it is issued at. The identification page gives an ID, ages 21 to 59, at $5.00 for 4 years (non-expiring from 60 if not REAL ID). No youngest age for the card was read.
